design_notes: Serif throughout, hairline rules, two rule weights; single accent colour for table headers and stat values.
Financial tables: right-align all figures, use tabular numerals, keep the ₹ crore unit in the column header only.
Industry snapshot stat strip: three equal columns separated by hairline rules, values in the accent colour, descriptors in small caps.
Growth bars: label the projected bar distinctly (e.g. lighter fill or an asterisk) to signal it is a projection, not actuals.
Pull-quotes: set in larger serif with a hairline rule above, no quotation-mark ornamentation beyond the marks themselves.
The 'as captured' table should read as a disclosure-gap exhibit — muted styling, no accent colour, so it does not look like a normal peer comparison.

pull_quotes.quote: Western Railway has been a client since 2006 and accounts for 52% of the orders on hand.

pull_quotes.rationale: The filing's own admission of negative cash flow is the sharpest single disclosed fact in the risk section and deserves to stand alone.

sidebars.body_markdown: The offer is 44,28,000 equity shares of ₹10 face value each, at a price the filing prints as ₹[•], not disclosed in the material available [^drhp-p29]. The excerpt presents a single line and does not split fresh issue from offer for sale, and no selling shareholder is named [^drhp-p29]. Of the objects, one is quantified: ₹1,130 lakhs (₹11.30 crore) to meet working capital requirements; the general corporate purposes amount is redacted [^drhp-p48]. No independent appraiser and no monitoring agency have been appointed, and deployment is at the discretion of the management and board, monitored by the audit committee [^drhp-p18]. Lead manager: Mark Corporate Advisors Private Limited; registrar: Bigshare Services Private Limited [^drhp-p31].
sidebars.rationale: Consolidates the offer's structural facts — size, price status, objects, oversight, intermediaries — into one scannable block the narrative sections cannot carry together.
sidebars.title: The offer at a glance
